body:
# Zink

Zink is a Crystal interpreter for Z-machine text adventures. It runs text-mode
version 3, 4, and 5 story files and exposes a JSON view of the object tree and
globals.

## Run

Requires Crystal 1.19.1 or newer.

```sh
crystal run src/main.cr -- path/to/story.z5
```

Or build an executable with `just build` and run `bin/zink path/to/story.z5`.
Use `--worldview` to boot a story, submit `look`, and print its state as JSON.
Use `--record-actions FILE` to record commands and keypresses, then
`--playback-commands FILE` to replay them. Playback returns to keyboard input
when the file ends. If a story requests playback without that option, the
console prompts for a command file. `--debug` prints VM instruction addresses
to standard error.

```sh
crystal spec
```

The suite includes the licensed CZECH interpreter checks for v3, v4, and v5. A
separate v4 art story smoke test can be run after downloading
[`art.z4`](https://ifarchive.org/if-archive/games/if-artshow/year2000/art.z4):

```sh
ZINK_ART_V4_STORY=/path/to/art.z4 crystal spec spec/integration/art_v4_spec.cr
```

That story stays outside the repository. The test fixture is the IF Art Show
2000 release (SHA-256 `5bb9d312c61f6af47c7d67fd138adf338ef3dba36163a0177da5904e49d6a962`).

## State API

`Zink::VM#worldview` returns a snapshot of the objects and all 240 global
variables. `Worldview#globals` is keyed by Z-machine variable number (16–255).
Each `WorldObject#property_bytes` entry contains the complete property data;
`properties` retains the one-byte or first-word values. The `location` field
uses global 16 in version 3. Later versions do not reserve a location global,
so their `location` field is zero.

`VM#export_save` and `VM#import_save` transfer execution state. The snapshot is
JSON serializable. `VM#export_save_for_persistence` rewinds to the latest input
instruction so a restored session can wait for a new command.

For embedded playback, pass `command_script:` to `ConsoleIO` or `ScriptedIO`.
Call `VM#select_input_stream(1)` to start playback immediately, or let the story
select it with `input_stream 1`.

## Code layout

- `Memory`, `Header`, and `Story` own story bytes and file metadata.
- `ObjectTable`, `TextDecoder`, and `Parser` handle version-dependent data.
- `VM` owns execution state. Opcode groups live in `src/zink/vm/`.
- `IODevice` handles host input and output. `WindowedIO` renders the upper
  Z-machine window as readable rows on a linear text device.

## Current limits

See [compatibility status](docs/compatibility.md) for tested versions and
prioritized follow-up work.

Zink advertises no colour, sound, graphics, mouse, or timed-input capability.
Transcript and command-file streams are available through `VM#transcript` and
`VM#recorded_commands`; Zink does not write those streams to files automatically.
Extended
ZSCII character mapping and true single-key terminal input are not implemented;
for `read_char`, type a key followed by Enter. Save/restore and auxiliary saves
use memory within a running VM; an application can persist snapshots through the
state API above. Command-file playback supports printable ASCII and bracketed
ZSCII key codes; extended ZSCII text is still incomplete.
The upper window is rendered as a linear transcript, so screen redraws cannot
match a full terminal display.

def.name: run
def.body:
begin
  debug = !(!(ENV["ZINK_DEBUG"]? == "1"))
  max_steps : Int32 | ::Nil = nil
  story_path : String | ::Nil = nil
  record_actions_path : String | ::Nil = nil
  playback_commands_path : String | ::Nil = nil
  dump_worldview = false

  exit_code : Int32 | ::Nil = nil

  parser = OptionParser.new do |opts|
    opts.banner = "Usage: zink [options] STORY_FILE.z3|.z4|.z5"
    opts.separator("Hint: set ZINK_DEBUG=1 for VM trace output")

    opts.on("--debug", "Enable VM trace output") do debug = true end
    opts.on("--max-steps N", "Limit VM execution steps") do |n| max_steps = n.to_i end
    opts.on("--record-actions FILE", "Record player input to a file") do |f| record_actions_path = f end
    opts.on("--playback-commands FILE", "Replay commands from a file") do |f| playback_commands_path = f end
    opts.on("--worldview", "Boot game and dump worldview as JSON") do dump_worldview = true end
    opts.on("-h", "--help", "Show this help") do
      STDERR.puts(opts)
      exit_code = 0
    end

    opts.unknown_args do |positional|
      if positional.size > 1
        STDERR.puts("Error: multiple story paths provided")
        STDERR.puts(opts)
        exit_code = 1
      end
      story_path = positional.first?
    end

    opts.invalid_option do |flag|
      STDERR.puts("Error: unknown option '#{flag}'")
      STDERR.puts(opts)
      exit_code = 1
    end

    opts.missing_option do |flag|
      STDERR.puts("Error: #{flag} requires a value")
      STDERR.puts(opts)
      exit_code = 1
    end
  end

  parser.parse(args)
  if code = exit_code
    return code
  end

  if story_path
  else
    STDERR.puts(parser)
    return 1
  end

  debug_mode = !(!debug)
  if debug_mode
    STDERR.puts("Debug mode enabled")
  end

  story = Story.load(story_path.not_nil!)
  if story.header.version >= 3_u8 && story.header.version <= 5_u8
  else
    STDERR.puts("Only Z-machine versions 3, 4, and 5 are supported (got v#{story.header.version}).")
    return 2
  end

  if debug_mode
    STDERR.puts("Loaded story: version=#{story.header.version} entry_pc=0x#{story.entry_pc.to_s(16)} static_base=0x#{story.header.static_memory_base.to_s(16)} size=#{story.file_length} bytes")
  end

  if dump_worldview
    wv_io = ScriptedIO.new(["look"])
    wv_vm = VM.new(story, wv_io, debug: debug_mode)
    wv_vm.run(100000)
    puts(wv_vm.worldview.to_pretty_json)
    return 0
  end

  command_script = playback_commands_path.try do |path| File.read(path) end
  base_io = ConsoleIO.new(command_script: command_script)
  recording_io : RecordingIO | ::Nil = nil
  io : IODevice = base_io
  if path = record_actions_path
    recording_io = RecordingIO.new(base_io, path)
    io = recording_io
    if debug_mode
      STDERR.puts("Recording player actions to #{path}")
    end
  end

  begin
    vm = VM.new(story, io, debug: debug_mode)
    if command_script
      vm.select_input_stream(1)
    end
    if limit = max_steps
      vm.run(limit)
    else
      vm.run_unbounded
    end
  ensure
    recording_io.try(&.close)
  end
  0
rescue ex : Exception
  STDERR.puts("Error: #{ex.message}")
  if debug_mode
    if backtrace = ex.backtrace?
      backtrace.each do |line| STDERR.puts("  #{line}") end
    end
  end
  3
end

end

raw = @input.gets
if raw
else

end

end

def.name: read_line
def.body:
raw = @input.gets
if raw
else
  return nil
end

String.build do |result|
  (decode(raw)).each do |code|
    if code >= 32 && code <= 126
    else
      raise(ArgumentError.new("Unsupported ZSCII command character #{code}"))
    end
    result << code.chr
  end
end

def.name: command_script
def.body:
begin
  if @command_script
    return @command_script
  end

  write("\nCommand file to replay (blank to cancel): ")
  path = @input.gets
  if path.nil? || path.empty?
    return nil
  end
  File.read(path)
rescue ex : File::Error
  write("\nCannot open command file: #{ex.message}\n")
  nil
end

def.name: write
def.body:
rendered = String::Builder.new
word = String::Builder.new

text.each_char do |char|
  if @skip_space_after_prompt && (char == ' ')
    @skip_space_after_prompt = false
    next
  end
  @skip_space_after_prompt = false

  case char
  when '\r'
    next
  when '\n'
    emit_word(rendered, word.to_s)
    word = String::Builder.new
    rendered << '\n'
    @column = 0
    @line_start = true
  else
    if @line_start && (char == '>')
      emit_word(rendered, word.to_s)
      word = String::Builder.new
      rendered << "> "
      @column = @column + 2
      @line_start = false
      @skip_space_after_prompt = true
    elsif char.whitespace?
      emit_word(rendered, word.to_s)
      word = String::Builder.new
      emit_space(rendered)
    else
      word << char
    end
  end
end

emit_word(rendered, word.to_s)
@output << rendered.to_s

def.name: read
def.body:
if memory.size < 64
  raise(FormatError.new("Story file too small: #{memory.size} bytes"))
end

version = memory.read_byte(0)
if version >= 1 && version <= 8
else
  raise(FormatError.new("Unsupported Z-machine version: #{version}"))
end

Header.new(version: version, high_memory_base: memory.read_word(4), initial_pc: memory.read_word(6), dictionary_table: memory.read_word(8), object_table: memory.read_word(10), globals_table: memory.read_word(12), static_memory_base: memory.read_word(14), abbreviations_table: memory.read_word(24), file_length_words: memory.read_word(26))

def.name: file_length_bytes
def.body:
if file_length_words == 0_u16
  return fallback_size
end
file_length_words.to_i * file_length_multiplier

def.name: file_length_multiplier
def.body:
case version
when 1..3
  2
when 4..5
  4
else
  8
end

def.name: unpack_address
def.body:
case version
when 1..3
  packed_address.to_i * 2
when 4..5
  packed_address.to_i * 4
when 8
  packed_address.to_i * 8
else
  raise(FormatError.new("Packed address decoding for v#{version} requires routine/string offsets"))
end

def.name: get_next_property_number
def.body:
if property_number == 0_u8
else
  property_bounds_check(property_number)
end

entries = property_entries(object_number)
if entries.empty?
  return 0_u8
end

if property_number == 0_u8
  return entries.first[0]
end

entries.each_with_index do |entry, index|
  number, _, _ = entry
  if number == property_number
  else
    next
  end

  if (index + 1) >= entries.size
    return 0_u8
  end
  return entries[index + 1][0]
end

raise(RuntimeError.new("Property #{property_number} not found on object #{object_number}"))

def.name: property_length
def.body:
if property_data_address == 0_u16
  return 0_u8
end
header = @memory.read_byte(property_data_address.to_i - 1)
if @header.version <= 3
  return ((header >> 5) + 1).to_u8
end

if (header & 128_u8) != 0
  size = header & 63_u8
  size == 0_u8 ? 64_u8 : size
else
  (header & 64_u8) == 0 ? 1_u8 : 2_u8
end

def.name: put_property
def.body:
property_bounds_check(property_number)
location = find_property(object_number, property_number)
if location
else
  raise(RuntimeError.new("Property #{property_number} not found on object #{object_number}"))
end

_, size, data_address = location
case size
when 1
  @memory.write_byte(data_address, (value & 255).to_u8)
when 2
  @memory.write_word(data_address, value)
else
  raise(RuntimeError.new("put_prop supports only size 1 or 2 (property #{property_number} has size #{size})"))
end

def.name: remove_object
def.body:
current_parent = parent(object_number)
if current_parent == 0_u16
  return
end

current_sibling = sibling(object_number)
first_child = child(current_parent)
if first_child == object_number
  set_child(current_parent, current_sibling)
else
  cursor = first_child
  while cursor != 0_u16
    cursor_sibling = sibling(cursor)
    if cursor_sibling == object_number
      set_sibling(cursor, current_sibling)
      break
    end
    cursor = cursor_sibling
  end
end

set_parent(object_number, 0_u16)
set_sibling(object_number, 0_u16)

class_methods.args_string: (token : String, version : UInt8, alphabet_table : Bytes | Nil = nil) : Bytes

def.name: encode_dictionary_key
def.body:
encoded_chars = version <= 3 ? 6 : 9
word_count = encoded_chars // 3
zchars = [] of UInt8

token.each_char do |char|
  (encode_char(char, alphabet_table)).each do |zchar|
    if zchars.size >= encoded_chars
      break
    end
    zchars << zchar
  end
  if zchars.size >= encoded_chars
    break
  end
end

while zchars.size < encoded_chars
  zchars << 5_u8
end

bytes = Bytes.new(word_count * 2, 0_u8)
word_count.times do |index|
  first = zchars[index * 3].to_u16
  second = zchars[(index * 3) + 1].to_u16
  third = zchars[(index * 3) + 2].to_u16
  word = (((first << 10) | (second << 5)) | third).to_u16
  if index == (word_count - 1)
    word = word | 32768_u16
  end
  bytes[index * 2] = ((word >> 8) & 255).to_u8
  bytes[(index * 2) + 1] = (word & 255).to_u8
end

bytes

def.name: from_bytes
def.body:
preview = Memory.new(bytes)
header = Header.read(preview)

write_limit = header.static_memory_base.to_i
if write_limit <= 0 || write_limit > bytes.size
  write_limit = bytes.size
end

memory = Memory.new(bytes, write_limit: write_limit)
header = Header.read(memory)
declared_length = header.file_length_bytes(bytes.size)
file_length = Math.min(declared_length, bytes.size)

Story.new(memory, header, file_length)

def.name: decode_zstring_at
def.body:
zchars = [] of UInt8
pointer = address

loop do
  word = (@memory.read_word(pointer)).to_u16
  pointer = pointer + 2

  zchars << ((word >> 10) & 31).to_u8
  zchars << ((word >> 5) & 31).to_u8
  zchars << (word & 31).to_u8

  if (word & 32768) != 0
    break
  end
end

{decode_zchars(zchars, depth), pointer}

instance_methods.name: export_save_for_persistence
instance_methods.doc:
Export a snapshot with PC rewound to the last sread instruction.
On import + run_unbounded, the VM re-executes sread → read_line → blocks

def.name: run
def.body:
steps = 0

while (!@halted) && steps < max_steps
  step
  steps = steps + 1
end

case stream
when 0
  @playback = nil
when 1

    return

  script = @io.command_script

def.name: step
def.body:
opcode_address = @pc
opcode = read_next_byte
debug_log("pc=0x#{(opcode_address.to_s(16)).rjust(4, '0')} opcode=0x#{(opcode.to_s(16)).rjust(2, '0')}")

if (opcode == 190_u8) && @header.version >= 5
  execute_extended(opcode_address)
  return
end

if opcode >= 176 && opcode <= 191
  execute_0op((opcode & 15).to_i)
  return
end

case opcode
when 0_u8..127_u8
  execute_long_form(opcode, opcode_address)
when 128_u8..175_u8
  execute_short_form(opcode, opcode_address)
else
  execute_variable_form(opcode, opcode_address)
end

def.name: worldview
def.body:
globals = {} of UInt8 => UInt16
16.upto(255) do |variable_number|
  globals[variable_number.to_u8] = global(variable_number.to_u8)
end

location = @header.version <= 3 ? globals[16_u8] : 0_u16
location_name = object_name(location)

objects = [] of WorldObject
1.upto(@objects.object_count) do |number|
  num = number.to_u16
  objects << WorldObject.new(number: num, name: object_name(num), parent: (@objects.parent(num)).to_u16, children: @objects.children(num), attributes: @objects.active_attributes(num), properties: @objects.all_properties(num), property_bytes: @objects.all_property_bytes(num))
end

Worldview.new(location: location, location_name: location_name, objects: objects, globals: globals)
